extra_quotes: The analytical results are conﬁrmed by numerical simulations using the Lennard-Jones and Morse potentials.
The structural optimization was performed using the Broyden-Fletcher-Goldfarb-Shanno (BFGS) method [23].
In our analytical study, geometry relaxation in thin ﬁlms is not considered.
No convergence was obtained when ρ0 ≤ 2 for the Morse potential.
The eﬀects of substrates, encapsulation, and other environmental factors (e.g., strains) on the formation of non-vdW 2D structures are beyond the scope of the present work.
